label: noOverlap: the overlap check on the other axis dropped, so a frame beside A's corner counts as its neighbour
find: guard o0 < side1, o1 > side0 else { continue }
replace: guard o0 < side1 || o1 > side0 || true else { continue }

label: ownGapTwice: the equal-gap compare uses the box's own gap twice, so every gap with one beyond is a spacing hint
find: let matches = beyond.map { abs($0.gap - side.gap) <= Self.equalGap } ?? false
replace: let matches = beyond.map { _ in abs(side.gap - side.gap) <= Self.equalGap } ?? false

label: noCentre: spacingOffset drops the centred case
find: if let b = before, let a = after { options.append((a.gap - b.gap) / 2) }

label: noReach: a neighbour past 2,048 pt still counts
find: guard gap > 0, gap <= Self.reach else { continue }
